result.reason: The added clause reaches the preferred position by requiring up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, a machine-readable data return within 30 days, and written certification of deletion. However, it goes beyond the playbook by extending the return and deletion obligations to all Works and Confidential Information and by applying those obligations upon termination of any Statement of Work. This materially expands existing treatment of Works and may affect unrelated IP and confidentiality arrangements. Drafting is generally professional, but requiring all Works and Confidential Information to be returned in a machine-readable format is awkward, and “thereafter” provides no definite deletion or certification deadline.
